name: triceps-extension-machine
title: Triceps Extension: Machine
primer: This exercise uses a machine to ensure proper range of motion for triceps extensions.
steps: Adjust the seat height of the machine so your upper arms and elbows lie flat on the pad.
Draw your abs in and sit upright with your back straight.
With your elbows bent, grasp the handles and push them away from your body until your arms are fully extended.
Hold for a moment and then slowly return to the starting position.
tips: This is a good exercise for beginners and people rehabilitating from injury.
Stay seated and keep your feet firmly on the floor throughout this exercise.
